query:
MATCH p=(u:User)-[:HasProfileArtifact]->(a:ProfileArtifact)-[fo:FoundOn]->(c:Computer)
WITH u, a, count(DISTINCT c) AS computer_count, collect(DISTINCT c.name) AS computers, sum(coalesce(fo.findingcount, 0)) AS findings
WHERE computer_count > 1
RETURN u.name AS User, a.artifacttype AS ArtifactType, a.category AS Category, computer_count AS Computers, computers AS ComputerNames, findings AS Findings
ORDER BY Computers DESC, Findings DESC
name: Profilehound - Multi-Host Artifact Types
description: Finds collapsed artifact nodes for a user that are backed by evidence on multiple computers.
